description: Expected schema for healthcare authorization data.

fields.name: member_id
fields.description: Identifier of the member associated with the authorization.

fields.name: authorization_date
fields.description: Date on which the authorization was submitted or created.

fields.name: service_date
fields.description: Date associated with the requested healthcare service.

fields.name: service_type
fields.description: Type of healthcare service requiring authorization.

fields.name: submission_channel
fields.description: Channel through which the authorization was submitted.

fields.name: processing_time_hours
fields.description: Time taken to process the authorization in hours.

fields.name: missing_document_count
fields.description: Number of missing documents associated with the authorization.

fields.name: resubmission_count
fields.description: Number of times the authorization was resubmitted.
